case_variable: observed sign of angular motion around a physically verified roundabout center while the vehicle occupies its circulatory roadway
fixed_context: same authored ring geometry, island envelope, actor blueprint, weather, frame times, speed and lane within each paired candidate
witness_1: counterclockwise request; expected positive signed angular progress
witness_2: clockwise request; expected negative signed angular progress
fallback1: slower passage if entry island visibility is insufficient; threshold requires saved measurement
fallback2: wider outer-lane passage if measured lane-center deviation exceeds tolerance; threshold requires saved measurement
fallback3: stop before full passage if physical roundabout or traffic-control verification is absent
required_original_measurements: Native generated-map and physical roundabout readback
240 synchronized actor poses, velocities, body vertices, yaw rate and camera frames
continuous circulatory-road occupancy and signed angular velocity
accepted_membership_limit: Three historical accepted membership rows are context only; no original is replayed and equivalence is unverified
legal_limit: Authored headings and road geometry do not establish a physical roundabout, observed continuous travel direction or statutory verdict
